thread:
ci-bot: Build failed: main / unit-tests-linux #4321 — decrypt error in secret fetch. Logs: `Error: DECRYPT: googleapi: Error 403: Permission "cloudkms.cryptoKeyVersions.useToDecrypt" denied` https://ci.redwood/runs/4321 :warning:
Alex: heads up — main is red, looks like runners can't decrypt secrets. seeing KMS AccessDenied in logs.
Priya: i rolled the GHA OIDC trust config earlier today to tighten scopes, but i didn't touch KMS IAM directly. could that have broken workload identity? :thinking:
Sam: we use workload identity: github action -> GCP SA `ci-runner@redwood-prod`. if that binding was removed or the OIDC audience changed, SA won't be usable to call KMS. checking right now.
Lina: vault-agent shows `vault: transit/decrypt permission denied` when pulling the transit key. secret-sync job errored with 403. timeline: secret-rotation job at 09:12 then OIDC change ~09:20.
Josh: can someone rerun the failing job while we triage? if it's just transient we can un-block main.
Alex: @ci-bot please rerun main/4321 once we confirm fix. otherwise request bisect of commits between HEAD~10..HEAD.
Sam: quick check: run `gcloud iam service-accounts get-iam-policy ci-runner@redwood-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com` and `gcloud iam service-accounts add-iam-policy-binding` if binding missing. also: check `gcloud iam workload-identity-pools providers describe github-provider` for audience mismatch.
Priya: i reverted the OIDC audience tweak and re-applied the trust binding. i'll trigger a vault role re-sync as well. give me 3m. :thumbsup:
ci-bot: Rerun requested by Priya — started run https://ci.redwood/runs/4322 (job id 4322).
Lina: watching logs: secret-sync now succeeds, vault-agent can decrypt transit key, no 403s in the stream.
Sam: if rerun still fails, we should bisect to find which PR introduced the change to the infra pipeline. but i'm hopeful the revert fixes it.
ci-bot: Run 4322 finished — all unit-tests-linux jobs green.
Alex: nice, main is green again. thanks Priya/Sam/Lina for the quick triage. :tada:
Priya: i'll open a short incident note with timeline and follow-up (roll back the OIDC change, add automated test for OIDC/audience in CI).
Josh: can we also add a quick alert for `transit decrypt 403` so oncall sees it next time?
Lina: yes, adding an alert rule and a runbook entry now. i'll paste the runbook link in the incident note.
Alex: closing here — please add any follow-ups to the incident ticket.
